import logging
from datetime import timedelta

from celery import shared_task
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from tracking.models import ScanEvent, Shipment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@shared_task(bind=True, max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=30)
def reconcile_scans(self, depot_id: int) -> int:
    cutoff = timezone.now() - timedelta(hours=2)
    stale = Shipment.objects.filter(depot_id=depot_id, status="in_transit", last_scan_at__lt=cutoff)
    fixed = 0
    for shipment in stale.select_related("route"):
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                ScanEvent.objects.create(shipment=shipment, kind="MISSED_SCAN", at=timezone.now())
                shipment.flag_exception()
                fixed += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("reconcile failed for %s", shipment.pk)
            raise self.retry(exc=exc)
    return fixed
